credential: per-attempt machine credential (Authorization: Bearer, X-AQ-Request: 1); the project is taken from the authenticated binding, never from the body. Both routes need result.read at project scope (project:self or the attempt's own project:<id>); attempt:self, task:self and task:subtree do not reach results

response.complete: false when any listed report could not be read; the healthy reports are still returned
response.unavailable: [{report_id, reason}] one per unreadable report; reason is outside_coverage, refused, temporarily_unavailable or validation_failed

request.revision: the exact report digest, 64 lowercase hex

response.work: where the revision's work is retained: state pushed_ref (provenance: repository_id, base, head, ref, digest; patch.retrieve lists the steps that read the diff), push_conflict, source_receipts_only or missing (explicit evidence; nothing is recreated or approved). patch.served is false: aq-git serves refs and name-status, not patch bytes. provenance.digest binds revision, repository, base, head and ref, not patch bytes
